gaps.title: Exact sword victim contacts
gaps.detail: resolveSword() changes enemy/Griffin HP without a stable per-victim sword-hit record. HP differences cannot identify every strike, source or sub-snapshot hit. Swing seq is usable; exact contact audio is deferred.

gaps.title: Unguarded melee, nest-defense and headbutt contacts
gaps.detail: damage() and Griffin attackHits mutate state, but there is no retained general damage-event stream. A HP delta can indicate hurt, not reliably identify each source/contact. Multiple hits or a full lethal reset may be lost between snapshots. defensiveHit.seq is a separate usable guarded-hit observation.

gaps.title: Lethal damage versus other recovery
gaps.detail: Lethal damage resets HP to 100 immediately and increments movementEpoch. The epoch also changes for movement recovery/corrections. It is not a reliable death/respawn event; do not derive a death cue from it.

gaps.title: Mirror reflection before an immediate torch/wall hit
gaps.detail: pondReflection can be set and the projectile removed in the same server tick. A client may only receive the final impact and torch latch, losing the intermediate reflection and its position. A disappeared projectile is also not necessarily an impact.

gaps.title: Short phase/contact/occupancy edges between snapshots
gaps.detail: Griffin phases/contactId+impactClock, gate/plate states and held inputs describe current state, not complete event history. Multiple transitions can be coalesced between snapshots. Use stable latches for completion, avoid promising every transient edge, and never replay baseline states after reconnect.

gaps.title: Generic pickup acknowledgements and replayed requests
gaps.detail: An inventory receipt or revision alone is not a new acquisition. Compare claimed/unlocked/completed and counts/tool delivery flags. Cached/repeated successes must stay silent. Story give/take and grooming consumption require their own state edges.

gaps.title: Predicted casts and source identity
gaps.detail: Predicted local presentation may precede accepted casts. Reconcile by accepted action/projectile IDs or wait; do not play twice. Black Hole also sets combat.kind=cast, so kind alone cannot identify Fireball.
